trust_decision.summary: The agent's createConnection override decides whether a literal-IP host is allowed (validateIPAddress) and, on rejection, must report the error asynchronously via connectionListener/socket error instead of throwing synchronously out of http.request.

landing_point.why: The summary names createConnection() and literal private-IP hosts; the only `throw validationError` in that method is here, in the first (HTTP) agent class.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: new RequestFilteringHttpAgent() / globalHttpAgent / useAgent('http://...') passed as agent to http.request/http.get
public API: new RequestFilteringHttpsAgent() / globalHttpsAgent / useAgent('https://...') passed as agent to https.request/https.get
fix_sites.module_kind: core library class (HTTPS agent, copy-pasted twin in same file)

fix_sites.entry_point: new helper createConnectionErrorSocket called from both createConnection overrides

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The HTTPS twin at src/request-filtering-agent.ts:278-294 is a copy in the same file, 40 lines below the landing point; not a distant second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: a solver could argue the HTTPS agent is a separate class, but it is identical code in the same file and both agents are named in the README/useAgent, so it is not plausibly dismissible.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Rejected literal-IP requests must still fail with the 'It is private IP address' / meta / denyIPAddressList error (surfaced as request 'error' / fetch rejection), and allowed literal IPs (allowPrivateIPAddress, allowIPAddressList) must still connect; a fix that swallows the error or skips validation breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: literal IPv4 host via http agent
literal IPv4 host via https agent
createConnection called with connectionListener (error passed to callback)
createConnection called without connectionListener (socket destroyed with error)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A synchronous throw inside the lookup wrapper (e.g. validating hostname before calling lookup) instead of cb(err)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding a pre-lookup hostname check could naturally `throw` there; it runs inside net.connect's lookup and would similarly escape the request error path.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A useAgent/constructor-time validation that throws for an invalid option or URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Option validation is flagged as a TODO to become a throw (src/request-filtering-agent.ts:73-74); but constructor throws are synchronous by design, so this sibling is weak.

O9_family: Uncaught exception / improper error propagation in an SSRF-filtering HTTP agent (CWE-248)

O10_build.project_tests: test/request-filtering-agent.test.ts (node:test via tsx; uses a local http server on port 12456 and node-fetch; one test relies on DNS for the lookup-path case)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace `throw validationError` with process.nextTick emit / return a destroyed socket in the HTTP agent only, or wrap in try/catch and ignore, missing the HTTPS twin or the no-callback case.

out_of_scope_notes: Literal-IP check uses validateIPAddress({address: host}) without family/host, so error messages show 'family:undefined'; cosmetic, not pursued.
